markdown.scope: Explicit documents only; no site build

examples.scope: Official K8s1.36.2 OpenAPI schemas and local loopbackHTTP fixture; flag-presence AST inspection, not actual vLLM argparse/runtime validation. No weights/GPU/server/cloud execution.

authMiddleware.scope: Unmodified ASGI middleware with in-memory scope/receive/send and synthetic token. No network, vLLM server/model/GPU or cloud execution.

arithmetic.scope: Arithmetic on pinned model config and historical reported values; not GPU profiling or benchmark reproduction.

responsive.scope: Standalone viewer after the same production font/responsive normalization; no full VitePress build.

Image metadata/digest and Kubernetes schemas do not prove non-root container/kernel/model behavior.
